1 cup butter

3/4 cup packed brown sugar

3/4 cup white sugar

1 egg

1 teaspoon vanilla

2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour

1 teaspoon baking soda

1 teaspoon salt

2 1/4 cups semisweet chocolate chips

1 cup chopped pecans

2 teaspoons cinnamon

Procedure:

1.  Cream butter and sugars in a large bowl until light and fluffy.

2.  Add egg, vanilla, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon, beating well after each addition.

3.  Combine flour, baking soda, and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips, pecans, and remaining 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
